chapter.verse: Jesu Khris' sila khat leh James' sanggampa ahi keimah Jude in, Pa Pasian' sungah itna a ngah, Jesu Khris' adingin a kikoihcing, sapkhiat mite kong hopih hi.
Note' tungah thukhualna, nopna lemna leh itna a tampi hong om ta hen.

Kong itte aw, i sankhop hotkhiatna thu tawh kisai laikhak hong gelh dingin hihtheihtawp ka hahkat laitak mahin mi siangthote' tungah tawntung' ading khatvei hong ki-ap upna thu na gimpih nadingun zong hanthotna lai kong gelhloh phamawh ka sa hi.

A hang pen kihtakbei misiate ahihna uh tawh gawtna a thuak dingin sawtpi pek pan min kigelhsa ahi mi kimkhat, i phawk loh kalin hong lut sim khin uh hi. Tua mite in i Pasian' hehpihna thu pen cilesa paktatna lamah heikhia uh a, khat bek i neih Mangpa Lianbel leh Topa ahi Jesu Khris nial uh hi.
Tua hi a, khatvei lai-in cingtakin na theihsa uh ahi zongin tu-in kong phawnkiknop thu ah Jesu in Egypt gam panin teeltuam mipawl a hotkhiat hangin a nung ciangin a um lote susia veve, cih thu hi.
Tua Jesu in amau' uktheihna panmun a thudon lo, amau' aituam tenna phual a nusia vanmite zong ni thupini ah thukhenna a thuak dingin a tawntunga kip kolbulh khaukhih tawh khuamial sungah khumcip hi.
Nulepa tatkhialhna bawlin pumpi tuamdang a lunggulh Sodom leh Gomorrah leh a kiim-a om khuapi teng zong tua bang mah hi a, tawntung meili sunga gawtna tuak uh ahih manin etsakna lim khat suak uh hi.
Himah taleh hih mite zong tua dan mahin a mangmatte uhah kinga-in cilesa pumpi thanghuaisak uh a, ukna thu nialin vanglian minphate daisak uh hi.
Ahi zongin vanmi mangpa Michael in Moses' luang vai-in dawimangpa tawh thu kituhin kam a kisel lai-un zahpih thukhenna pulak ngam lo-in, “Topa in nang hong taai ta hen,” bek na ci hi.
Himah taleh hih mite in a theih loh khempeuh uh zahpih uh a, amau' theihte lah pianpih theihtawm thu teng bek ahih manin khinkhaina neilo ganhingte bangin tua teng tawh kisia uh hi.
Tua mite a dahhuaizia! A hang pen tua mite in Cain' tot lampi zui-in thaman deihna tawh Balaam' khialhna lamah kipiatawm uh a, Koran ii lehdona nam tawh kisia uh hi.

Amaute pen itna ankuang na uumkhopnate uhah thusia melseelte ahi uh hi. Maizumna nei lo-in note tawh ankuang hong uumkhawm uh a, amaumah gilvahtak kivak uh hi. Amaute pen huih' mutkhiat, guahtui neilo meiilomte bang; phalbi sungin nihvei kungkeu-in a zung pan a kilongkhia, gah neilo singkungte bang;
amau' maizum nading mahin ninlom tuiphuan a thehto tuipi tuihualte bang; leh a tawntung' ading khuamial sahpi a kikoihkholhsak a vakvai aksite bang, ahi uh hi.
Hih thute mah Adam pan khang sagihna ahi Enoch in kamsanna na nei a, “En un, Topa ama' mi siangtho tul tampite tawh hong pai hi.

Amah in mi khempeuh' tungah thukhen ding a, kihtakbei misiate a vekun kihtakbei-a a gamtat khempeuh uh ahi zongin, ama' langkhat ah kihtakbei mawhneite' paukhiat kam khauh khempeuh ahi zongin laktel ding hi,” ci hi.
Hih mite pen a phunphunte, hoihsak a neilote, amau' cilesa lunggulhna bangin a gamtate, kam dimdim pau-in a kisialte, aituam met nadingin mi a mai-ette, ahi uh hi.
Kong itte aw, no na hih uhleh i Topa Jesu Khris ii sawltakte' genkholh thute na phawk un.
Sawltakte in note' kiangah, “Khanghun nunung ciangin kihtakbeina tawh amau' cilesa lunggulhna bangin a gamta, mizahpihte hong om ding hi,” hong ci uh hi.
Tuate pen kikhenkhapna a piangsak, a leitungvai, Kha a neilo mite ahi uh hi.
Kong itte aw, no na hih uhleh nomau' siangbel upna sungah nomaumah kilamkip unla, Kha Siangtho tawh thungen un.
Pasian' itna sungah nomaumah kikembit unla, tawntung nuntakna hong tunpih ding i Topa Jesu Khris ii thukhualna lamenin om un.
A muanglahte na khual un.
Mi kimkhat meikuang sungpan kaikhia-in na honkhia un. Cilesa tawh a nin mite a puantual sungsilh nangawn uh na kih kawm mahun Pasian kihtakna tawh tua mite na khual un.
Tu-in puktheihna pan note a hong hu zo ding, ama' minpha omna mai-ah nakpi nuamna tawh sitbaanglo-in a hong tunpih zo ding ahi,

khat bek Pasian, i Honpa' tungah i Topa Jesu Khris' tungtawnin minpha, vanglianpi, ukzawhna leh uktheihna cihte a beisa khanghun khempeuh leh tu laitak leh khanghun khempeuh dongah om den ta hen. Amen.
